output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly a SlotBook effect. RR-17 sent 1,610 SlotBook tickets to an unstaffed P4 queue, with a 21-day median and 17 days before first action. This accounts for about 70% of the gap. Matched Arts and non-Arts tickets differ by under 0.3 days, so Arts is not deprioritised generally. Lindqvist's twice-weekly on-site cover explains much of the remainder, as Education shows the same delays. Volume is not fully SlotBook and is not driven by trivial or duplicate tickets. The acknowledgement email hides the best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unresolved. The SSO link is unproven. Preferred: agree SlotBook support terms in writing, fix the acknowledgement, and report monthly. Hold the Arts desk transfer, forced migration and blanket best-effort until verified.
